description: This file is the minified source code of mustache.js, a JavaScript library for logic-less templates using Mustache syntax. It defines the Mustache object, its methods, and internal classes for parsing and rendering templates.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents a rendering context, maintaining view data and hierarchy.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: Handles parsing templates and rendering tokens into strings, with caching support.

classes.name: Scanner
classes.description: A utility class for tokenizing template strings during parsing.

methods.name: parseTemplate
methods.description: Parses a template string into a token tree based on Mustache syntax.

methods.name: squashTokens
methods.description: Combines consecutive text tokens into a single token for efficiency.

methods.name: nestTokens
methods.description: Converts a flat list of tokens into a nested structure representing sections.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached templates in the Writer instance.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses and caches a template string into tokens.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template string with a given view and partials.

methods.name: renderTokens
methods.description: Renders an array of tokens into a string using a context.

methods.name: renderSection
methods.description: Renders a section token based on the context value.

methods.name: renderInverted
methods.description: Renders an inverted section if the value is falsy.

methods.name: unescapedValue
methods.description: Returns the unescaped value for a token.

methods.name: escapedValue
methods.description: Returns the HTML-escaped value for a token.

methods.name: rawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw text of a token.
